title: What's New: Autofill Contact Details with Copilot (2025 release wave 2)

features.name: Copilot Autofill with Web Search for Contact Details
features.description: Copilot can search the web using Microsoft Bing to automatically fill out contact details such as addresses, phone numbers, email, and homepage fields when creating vendors or other records.
features.status_evidence_quote: go try out the public preview view of C-Pilot's autofill feature
caveats: Language quality has only been assessed for English
Support for additional languages is coming later in the wave
Not all fields may support web search

features.name: Info Tips for Transparency
features.description: Users can click info tips to see how Copilot derived each suggestion, including which web search result was used, and can follow a link to the grounding data source.
features.status_evidence_quote: go try out the public preview view of C-Pilot's autofill feature

features.name: Keep All Button
features.description: A single-click button that allows users to accept all Copilot suggestions at once, after which Business Central validates each field to maintain data integrity.
features.status_evidence_quote: go try out the public preview view of C-Pilot's autofill feature

features.name: Copilot Autofill Beyond Web Search
features.description: Copilot can provide suggestions not just from web search, but also from internal Business Central data such as recently used responsibility centers or the most common responsibility center in use.
features.status_evidence_quote: go try out the public preview view of C-Pilot's autofill feature

features.name: Enable Bing Search in Copilot and Agent Capabilities
features.description: Administrators can enable Bing search through the Copilot and agent capabilities page to allow Copilot to enhance its autofill results with web search data for contact details.
features.status_evidence_quote: go try out the public preview view of C-Pilot's autofill feature

features.name: Autofill Keyboard Shortcuts
features.description: Users can invoke Copilot autofill using Alt+I shortcut and toggle between info tips using Alt+Up to see where Copilot sourced the suggestions.
features.status_evidence_quote: go try out the public preview view of C-Pilot's autofill feature
